topic: Setting House Rules with a Roommate

script.title: OUR HOUSE RULES
script.story_hook: Two roommates sit down to write house rules.
script.intro_zh: 兩位室友坐下來，一起寫家規。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a roommate planning night. Listen for rules and polite deals.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到室友一起訂家規的夜晚。留意說服與妥協的說法。
script.outro_zh: 家規寫好了，感情也更好了。真棒！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's say each rule line aloud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，讓我們把每條家規大聲念出來。
script.char_a_description: an Asian man in his early twenties with short straight black hair and round glasses, wearing a yellow basketball jersey, gray shorts and white sneakers, lanky build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her early twenties with an auburn top bun, wearing denim overalls over a striped long-sleeve shirt, red canvas shoes and small flower earrings, medium build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, should we write our house rules down?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃʊd wi raɪt ɑɹ haʊs ɹulz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，我們把家規寫下來好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! I made tea and got a notebook.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ meɪd ti ænd ɡɑt ə ˈnoʊtˌbʊk/
dialogue.zh: 好！我泡了茶，還拿了本子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great start. Dishes first, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt stɑɹt ˈdɪʃɪz fɚst oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很好的開頭。先說碗盤好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. Wash dishes right after eating.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɹid wɑʃ ˈdɪʃɪz ɹaɪt ˈæftɚ ˈitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 同意。吃完馬上洗碗盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, honest answer... I leave bowls for days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɑnəst ˈænsɚ aɪ liv boʊz fɔɹ deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 呃，老實說…我會放好幾天才洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too! Soak them overnight, then scrub.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu soʊk ðɛm ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt ðɛn skɹʌb/
dialogue.zh: 我也是！先泡水放過夜，再刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds fair. I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz fɛɹ aɪ kæn du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣很公道。我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, guests. How often can friends come?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ɡɛsts haʊ ˈɔfən kæn fɹɛndz kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 接著是訪客。朋友可以多久來一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, weekends are fine for game night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈwikˌɛndz ɑɹ faɪn fɔɹ ɡeɪm naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，週末辦遊戲夜沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleepovers, how many nights a week?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipˌoʊvɚz haʊ ˈmɛni naɪts ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 過夜的客人，一週可以幾晚？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe two nights max, then tell me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi tu naɪts mæks ðɛn tɛl mi/
dialogue.zh: 最多兩晚，而且要提前告訴我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. Same rule for both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil seɪm ɹul fɔɹ boθ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 說定。你我同一規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. What about quiet hours?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈkwaɪət ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 很公道。那安靜時段呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, I study early, so ten to seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ ˈstʌdi ˈɜɹli soʊ tɛn tə ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 我早睡用功，十點到七點要安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Headphones for late videos.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz fɔɹ leɪt ˈvidioʊz/
dialogue.zh: 了解。深夜看影片要戴耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly! Loud music before ten is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli laʊd ˈmjuzɪk bɪˈfɔɹ tɛn ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對！十點前大聲聽音樂可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, big topic, money. Bills split?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bɪɡ ˈtɑpɪk ˈmʌni bɪlz splɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，大問題…錢。帳單對半？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half each, electric, water, and wifi.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf itʃ ɪˈlɛktɹɪk ˈwɔɾɚ ænd ˈwaɪfaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 電費、水費、網路，都對半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pay by the fifth or sixth?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi peɪ baɪ ðə faɪfθ ɔɹ sɪksθ/
dialogue.zh: 我們五號前付，還是六號前？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifth, and Venmo me right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪfθ ænd ˈvɛnmoʊ mi ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 五號，之後立刻轉給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy. Last month's bill arrived already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi læst mʌnθs bɪl əˈɹaɪvd ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 簡單。上個月的帳單到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sixty-eight total, so thirty-four each.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsɪksti‿eɪt ˈtoʊtl̩ soʊ ˈθɜɹdi fɔɹ itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 總共六十八，一人三十四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send it tonight, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ɪt təˈnaɪt ˈpɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就付，不拖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! That solves the bill thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðæt sɑlvz ðə bɪl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！帳單的事搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleaning rotation: who starts Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinɪŋ roʊˈteɪʃən hu stɑɹts ˈsæɾɚdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 打掃輪班：週六誰先開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll do it. You do the bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl du ɪt ju du ðə ˈbæθɹum/
dialogue.zh: 我來。浴室換你好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the bathroom. Okay, I'll take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ ðə ˈbæθɹum oʊˈkeɪ aɪl teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 唉，浴室。好吧，我負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We trade every two weeks, sounds good?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɹeɪd ˈɛvɹi tu wiks saʊndz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 兩週對調一次，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good! Fridge next. Do I get one shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd fɹɪdʒ nɛkst du aɪ ɡɛt wʌn ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 好！接著冰箱。我有一層擱架嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top shelf is yours, middle is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp ʃɛlf ɪz jɔɹz ˈmɪdəl ɪz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 上層歸你，中層歸我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And we label our own leftovers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wi ˈleɪbəl ɑɹ oʊn ˈlɛftˌoʊvɚz/
dialogue.zh: 自己的剩菜要貼名條？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Your mystery yogurt goes in the trash.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊɹ ˈmɪstɹi ˈjɑɡɔɹt ɡoʊz ɪn ðə tɹæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對！沒貼名的優格，我就當垃圾清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Learned that lesson last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ lɜnd ðæt ˈlɛsən læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！上個月我學到教訓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about your lunch. My bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt jʊɹ lʌntʃ maɪ bæd/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉吃了你的午餐，是我不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You ate my labeled chicken? I remember!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɛt maɪ ˈleɪbəld ˈtʃɪkən aɪ ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你吃了我貼名的雞肉？我還記得！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once! I paid you back for it, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns aɪ peɪd ju bæk fɔɹ ɪt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只有一次！我後來賠你了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve fifty. Paid. But no repeats.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈfɪfti peɪd bʌt noʊ ɹɪˈpits/
dialogue.zh: 十二塊五。付清了。不來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Trash nights: Tuesday and Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɹæʃ naɪts ˈtuzdeɪ ænd ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。倒垃圾：週二和週五？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set two phone alarms tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt tu foʊn əˈlɑɹmz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚設兩個手機鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Plants? Who waters the big one?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt plænts hu ˈwɔɾɚz ðə bɪɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。植物呢？那盆大的誰澆水？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neither of us! Rule: no new plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪðɚ ʌv ʌs ɹul noʊ nu plænts/
dialogue.zh: 我們都不澆！規矩：不買新植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, shoes off at the front door?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʃuz ɔf æt ðə fɹʌnt dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 進門要脫鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, guests too. The rug stays clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡɛsts tu ðə ɹʌɡ steɪz kliːn/
dialogue.zh: 要，客人也要。地毯保持乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that's most of everything written.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæts moʊst ʌv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ˈɹɪtn/
dialogue.zh: 好，大部分都寫完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small problem... my guitar practice?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɑl ˈpɑbləm maɪ ɡɪˈtɑɹ ˈpɹæktəs/
dialogue.zh: 還有個小問題…我練吉他？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah! The thumping at midnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðə ˈθʌmpɪŋ æt ˈmɪdaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 啊！半夜咚咚響的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wait till after dinner, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn weɪ tɪl ˈæftɚ ˈdɪnɚ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我改在晚飯以後練，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please! After eight works. Thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ˈæftɚ ɪt wɜɹks θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 拜託！八點後都可以。謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No amps after eight, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ æmps ˈæftɚ ɪt ˈpɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 八點後不用音箱，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're the best roommate already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ðə bɛst ˈɹumˌmeɪt ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 你已經是最好的室友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're not bad either. Sign the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ nɑt bæd ˈiðɚ saɪn ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 你也不差。要在清單上簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll sign if you add one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl saɪn ɪf ju æd wʌn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你再補一條我就簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pizza night, every single Friday. Fair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitsə naɪt ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈfɹaɪdeɪ fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 每週五都是披薩夜。公道吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best rule yet! Marker, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst ɹul jɛt ˈmɑɹkɚ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 最棒的一條！馬克筆在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Our kitchen table meeting worked!
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈaʊɚ ˈkɪtʃən ˈteɪbəl ˈmitɪŋ wɜɹkt/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。餐桌會議成功了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a home, not just a shared flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə hoʊm nɑt dʒʌst ə ʃɛrd flæt/
dialogue.zh: 這就叫家，不只是合租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll frame this list on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɹeɪm ðɪs lɪst ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我要把清單框起來掛牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't! The ink is still wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz doʊnt ði ɪŋk ɪz stɪl wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 拜託別！字還濕著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Roommate number one, official now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈɹumˌmeɪt ˈnʌmbɚ wʌn əˈfɪʃəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！正式成為室友一號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Official! Same time next month, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈfɪʃəl seɪm taɪm nɛkst mʌnθ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 定案！下個月同一時間，好嗎？

script.youtube_title: 【🏠「你已經是最好的室友了」】🎧60句合租家規聽力｜洗碗・訪客・帳單分攤｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🌱A2｜House Rules with a Roommate
script.youtube_title_en: "You're the Best Roommate Already" — Setting House Rules Together
script.youtube_description:
60句室友訂家規聽力練習：一碗泡著的麵碗，換來一張寫滿規矩的清單。

這一集是兩位室友在餐桌前的完整對話：從碗盤、訪客、安靜時段，一路談到帳單對半、打掃輪班、冰箱地盤，還有練吉他的時間怎麼喬。有妥協、有笑點、也有舊怨的小和解。

你會聽到：
- 提出規矩與討價還價的禮貌句型
- 分帳單、輪班打掃、冰箱分層說法
- 安靜時段與訪客過夜的妥協
- 簽「室友公約」的俏皮收尾

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of roommate house-rules listening practice: two friends sit at the kitchen table and write down the rules of living together — dishes, guests, quiet hours, bills, chores, the fridge, and one noisy guitar.

You will hear how to propose a rule, negotiate politely, split costs, and close with a laugh. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
合租第一週，誰洗碗？朋友過夜幾晚算多？帳單要怎麼分？

這一集帶大家坐進兩位室友的餐桌會議，從泡麵碗談到吉他聲，一條一條把家規寫下來，順便學會禮貌地講條件。

你會聽到：
